name: Devouring Plague
summary: Devouring Plague is a rite of passage quest for Forsaken priests journeying far from Lordaeron. Guided by the Forsaken priest trainer Miles Welsh in Thunder Bluff, the adept is directed back across the seas to Aelthalyste in the Undercity to unlock a signature manifestation of Shadow magic.

sections.title: A Summons Home
sections.body: While visiting Thunder Bluff, Forsaken priests who have honed their mastery over divine and shadowy disciplines are evaluated by Miles Welsh, an envoy of the Cult of Forgotten Shadow among the tauren. Recognizing that an acolyte has grown sufficiently in power, Miles bids them return to the Ruins of Lordaeron rather than attempt to impart these higher mysteries himself in Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Secrets of Aelthalyste
sections.body: Awaiting beneath the city ruins within the Undercity's War Quarter is Aelthalyste, one of the foremost mentors of Forsaken priesthood. She watches over the development of shadow-weaving acolytes, ensuring that the potent, draining blight known as the Devouring Plague is entrusted only to those capable of wielding its corruptive force without succumbing to it.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Miles Welsh, a Forsaken priest trainer stationed in the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, sends you on this journey once your abilities have developed sufficiently.
Aelthalyste resides in the War Quarter of the Undercity, standing among the training rings and dark conduits where Forsaken priests gather.

faq.q: Why can't Miles Welsh teach the spell himself?
faq.answer: Certain foundational mysteries of the Forsaken shadow faith are reserved for master mentors like Aelthalyste in the heart of the Undercity. Welsh honors this hierarchy by sending worthy adepts home to be tested.

faq.q: What is Devouring Plague from a lore perspective?
faq.answer: It is a devastating curse practiced by the Cult of Forgotten Shadow, afflicting the victim with a virulent magical affliction that consumes their vitality to restore the caster.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other races?
aliases: can trolls do devouring plague quest
faq.answer: No. The Devouring Plague quest is tied exclusively to the Forsaken priesthood, reflecting the unique philosophy and magical practices born of Lordaeron's undead survivors.

faq.q: Why is a Forsaken trainer in Thunder Bluff in the first place?
aliases: why are undead in thunder bluff
faq.answer: Following the Forsaken's admission into the Horde, diplomats and mentors were exchanged across capitals. Priests like Miles Welsh represent the Undercity's spiritual traditions and offer guidance to Forsaken traveling through Kalimdor.

angles.text: This quest marks an important milestone in a Forsaken priest's education, transitioning them from basic tenets into the dread Shadow traditions unique to the undead.
Unlike the Light practiced in life, Forsaken priests embrace harsh afflictions and Shadow magic, with Devouring Plague representing their distinct cultural magic.
The quest illustrates the logistical and spiritual bonds linking the distant Horde outposts in Mulgore directly back to the dark heart of the Undercity.
